get_campaign.description: Get one campaign with its goal, amount raised so far and number of donations.

get_donation.description: Get one donation with its donor, campaign, amount, fees, refunds, how often the donor gives ('frequency': one-time, monthly and so on) and answers to your form's questions.

frequency.description: (beta) How often the donor gives, as a word ready to use as a tag or in a message: one-time for a single gift; for a gift that is part of a recurring plan, how often the plan gives as Donorbox names it, in lower case, such as monthly (Donorbox also offers weekly, quarterly and annual plans); or recurring when Donorbox doesn't say which plan the gift belongs to. description: Read your Donorbox fundraising: campaigns, donations, donors, recurring plans and event tickets, and start workflows when a donation, donor, plan or ticket purchase comes in.

donorbox_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs for each new campaign in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.campaign: The whole campaign as Donorbox gives it.
output.goal_amt: The campaign's goal, if it has one.
output.name: The campaign's name.
output.slug: The campaign's slug, the last part of its donation page address.

donorbox_new_donation_trigger.description: Runs for each new donation in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.anonymous_donation: True if the donor asked to stay anonymous.
output.currency: The donation's currency, such as USD.
output.designation: The fund or cause the donor chose, if any.
output.donation: The whole donation as Donorbox gives it, with its answers.
output.first_recurring_donation: True if it is the first of a recurring plan.
output.formatted_amount: The amount with its currency sign, such as $100.
output.frequency: (beta) How often the donor gives, as a word ready to use as a tag or in a message: one-time for a single gift; for a gift that is part of a recurring plan, how often the plan gives as Donorbox names it, in lower case, such as monthly (Donorbox also offers weekly, quarterly and annual plans); or recurring when Donorbox doesn't say which plan the gift belongs to. Use it instead of testing 'recurring' and choosing a word.
output.recurring: True if it is part of a recurring plan.
output.status: The donation's status, such as paid.

parameters.description: Only for this campaign. Leave empty for every campaign.
parameters.name: campaign_id

donorbox_new_donor_trigger.description: Runs for each new donor in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.donations_count: How many donations they have made.
output.donor: The whole donor record as Donorbox gives it.
output.phone: The donor's phone number, if given.

donorbox_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new event in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.event: The whole event as Donorbox gives it.
output.name: The event's name.
output.slug: The event's slug, the last part of its page address.

donorbox_new_plan_trigger.description: Runs for each new recurring plan in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: The amount of each donation, such as 10.0.
output.formatted_amount: The amount with its currency sign, such as $10.
output.next_donation_date: The date of the next donation.
output.plan: The whole plan as Donorbox gives it.
output.status: The plan's status, such as active.
output.type: How often it gives, such as monthly.

parameters.description: Only for this campaign. Leave empty for every campaign.
parameters.name: campaign_id

donorbox_new_ticket_purchase_trigger.description: Runs for each new ticket purchase in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount_formatted: The amount with its currency sign.
output.purchase: The whole purchase as Donorbox gives it, with its tickets.
output.status: The purchase's payment status, such as paid.

parameters.description: Only for this event. Leave empty for every event.
parameters.name: event_id

donorbox_new_ticket_trigger.description: Runs for each new event ticket in Donorbox. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.free_ticket: True if the ticket was free.
output.price_formatted: The price with its currency sign.
output.purchase_id: The id of the purchase the ticket was bought in.
output.ticket: The whole ticket as Donorbox gives it, with the purchase.
output.ticket_type_name: The ticket type, such as General Admission.

parameters.description: Only for this event. Leave empty for every event.
parameters.name: event_id

donorbox_plan_cancelled_trigger.description: Runs each time a recurring plan is cancelled in Donorbox. Ones cancelled before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: The amount of each donation, such as 10.0.
output.formatted_amount: The amount with its currency sign, such as $10.
output.next_donation_date: The date of the next donation.
output.plan: The whole plan as Donorbox gives it.
output.status: The plan's status, such as active.
output.type: How often it gives, such as monthly.

parameters.description: Only for this campaign. Leave empty for every campaign.
parameters.name: campaign_id

donorbox_ticket_purchase_refunded_trigge.description: Runs each time an event ticket purchase is refunded in Donorbox. Ones refunded before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount_formatted: The amount with its currency sign.
output.purchase: The whole purchase as Donorbox gives it, with its tickets.
output.status: The purchase's payment status, such as paid.

parameters.description: Only for this event. Leave empty for every event.
parameters.name: event_id
